### SEVERITY: HIGH — Incorrect slicing in last_n
> util.py:15:     return items[len(items) - n - 1:]
The slice index calculation is off by one, causing the function to return $n+1$ elements instead of $n$. For example, if `items` is `[1, 2, 3]` and `n` is 2, the function calculates an index of 0 and returns `[1, 2, 3]` instead of the expected `[2, 3]`.

### SEVERITY: MEDIUM — ZeroDivisionError in mean
> util.py:19:     return sum(xs) / len(xs)
The function does not handle the case where the input list `xs` is empty. If an empty list is passed to the function, it will raise a `ZeroDivisionError` when attempting to divide by `len(xs)`.

VERDICT: FAIL
